description: Reports package existence, latest version and release, age, version count, npm weekly downloads, licenses, deprecation and known advisory severity. ok means no listed flags, not a safety guarantee. Supports npm, PyPI, Cargo, Go, Maven and NuGet. Optional exact version adds pinned-version metadata and uses deps.dev advisories; use /package-audit for OSV affected ranges and dated FIRST EPSS CVE estimates. Use before adding a dependency. Costs $0.002 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

ecosystem.description: One of npm, pypi, cargo, go, maven, nuget

name.description: Exact package name, e.g. lodash or @scope/name

version.description: Optional exact version to inspect; ranges and tags are not accepted
